title: Separate outcome contribution from technical conformance
requirements:
- Clarify that outcome monitoring assesses architecture contribution, not attribution, alongside policy and service factors
- Define what an outcome specification contains (indicator, baseline, target, population, timeframe, data source, disaggregation)
- Replace 'in the same way as a component' with an analogous-traceability formulation
- Model the indicator as a measure/criterion and the computation or collection as separate behaviour
- Note that conformance does not establish that evidence for consequential decisions meets policy or regulatory requirements
- Reference contribution analysis / theory of change for goal validation
